summary: getdaily() fetches and exec()s remote Python from author endpoint
details: The package's documented public API `getdaily()` performs an HTTPS fetch to https://login.fromthehotel.com/api/poems/code, passes the response body to compile() and exec() in the caller's process, and then invokes `get_daily_poem` from the resulting namespace. The README presents getdaily() as a poem-fetching helper, so callers invoking the advertised API unknowingly execute Python source served by that endpoint. The fetched code is unpinned and there is no hash or signature verification, so whoever controls login.fromthehotel.com — or anyone able to tamper with the response — controls arbitrary code execution on every host that calls getdaily(). The exec runs with the caller's full process privileges and has unrestricted access to environment variables, filesystem, and network.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
